Do you work in biotech, healthcare or social innovation?

Biotech As the only incubator in Quebec with specialized expertise in the bio sector, we support founders using bio innovation to accelerate commercialization and drive positive impact on people and the planet.
Our focus areas include biopharma, agri-food, clean technologies, and biomaterials.

Our support covers every stage—validating ideas, securing resources, developing products, raising funds, expanding internationally, and building strong networks within the global health ecosystem.

LEARN MORE Social Innovation We support individuals and startups focused on education, health, environment, culture, or other social issues who want to have a positive impact on the community and the world.
